sections.heading: Special driving situations — C
sections.markdown:
FACT_ID: sec08-F01 | anchor: A55
When police stop you, signal and move safely to the roadway's right side or the nearest safe stopping place. [A55]
Source: [A55 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec08-F02 | anchor: A55
At a police stop, select park and switch the ignition off or press the stop button. [A55]
Source: [A55 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec08-F03 | anchor: A55
Lower the window and stay inside the stopped vehicle unless the officer instructs otherwise. [A55]
Source: [A55 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec08-F04 | anchor: A55
Remain calm and keep the safety belt fastened during a police stop. [A55]
Source: [A55 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec08-F05 | anchor: A55
During a police stop, keep both hands visible on the steering wheel. [A55]
Source: [A55 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec08-F06 | anchor: A56
The handbook advises telling the officer at first contact if there are weapons in the vehicle. [A56]
Source: [A56 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec08-F07 | anchor: A56
Follow the officer's directions during a traffic stop. [A56]
Source: [A56 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec08-F08 | anchor: A56
When asked during a stop, provide your license, vehicle registration and insurance information. [A56]
Source: [A56 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec08-F09 | anchor: A56
Cooperate without arguing, and ask politely if an officer's instruction needs clarification. [A56]
Source: [A56 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec08-F10 | anchor: A56
A driver who disagrees with a traffic ticket may challenge it in court. [A56]
Source: [A56 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec08-F11 | anchor: A56
Keep vehicle lights on from sunset until sunrise. [A56]
Source: [A56 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec08-F12 | anchor: A56
Use vehicle lights in rain, snow, fog or other adverse atmospheric conditions at any hour. [A56]
Source: [A56 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec08-F13 | anchor: A56
Turn lights on whenever natural lighting does not permit a clear view of objects one thousand feet ahead. [A56]
Source: [A56 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec08-F14 | anchor: A56
Turn vehicle lights on whenever precipitation requires use of the windshield wipers. [A56]
Source: [A56 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec08-F15 | anchor: A56
At night, the headlight illumination limits how far ahead the driver can see. [A56]
Source: [A56 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec08-F16 | anchor: A56
Use a cautious, reasonable speed for night driving. [A56]
Source: [A56 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec08-F17 | anchor: A56
Use high beams when no traffic is approaching and dim them for oncoming vehicles. [A56]
Source: [A56 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec08-F18 | anchor: A56
To avoid temporary glare blindness, direct your gaze toward the road's right side when another vehicle approaches with bright headlights. [A56]
Source: [A56 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec08-F19 | anchor: A56
Glance to each side occasionally to locate the pavement edge and hazards coming from the sides. [A56]
Source: [A56 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0056]

sections.heading: Special driving situations — C2
sections.markdown:
FACT_ID: sec08-R01 | anchor: A56
Avoid sunglasses or colored lenses at night and on overcast days because they reduce vision. [A56]
Source: [A56 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec08-R02 | anchor: A57
In fog, travel more slowly with the traffic flow, maintain a consistent following gap and expect that a stop may be needed at any time. [A57]
Source: [A57 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec08-R03 | anchor: A57
In fog, use low beams rather than high beams and keep checking for hazards. [A57]
Source: [A57 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec08-R04 | anchor: A57
Keep shifting your gaze in fog instead of staring at one place. [A57]
Source: [A57 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec08-R05 | anchor: A57
After a crash in fog, move off the road as soon as it is safe; if the vehicle cannot move, leave lights and flashers on and place flares if possible. [A57]
Source: [A57 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec08-R06 | anchor: A57
Reduce speed for winter handling, especially on snowy or icy pavement. [A57]
Source: [A57 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec08-R07 | anchor: A57
Leave more space than usual behind other vehicles because slippery roads increase stopping distance. [A57]
Source: [A57 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec08-R08 | anchor: A57
Bridges, overpasses and shaded highway areas freeze before other locations. [A57]
Source: [A57 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec08-R09 | anchor: A57
The handbook describes light brake taps as a way to reduce momentum without losing traction in winter conditions. [A57]
Source: [A57 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec08-R10 | anchor: A57
If the vehicle skids, release the accelerator, steer in the skid's direction and do not apply the brakes while skidding. [A57]
Source: [A57 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec08-R11 | anchor: A57
A work zone is a roadwork area that may include closed lanes, detours and moving equipment. [A57]
Source: [A57 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec08-R12 | anchor: A57
On a work-zone approach, watch for signs, cones, barrels, large vehicles and workers. [A57]
Source: [A57 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec08-R13 | anchor: A57
Work-zone signs have orange backgrounds with black lettering or symbols. [A57]
Source: [A57 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec08-R14 | anchor: A57
Slow down in a work zone even if no workers are present because narrow lanes and rough pavement can still be hazardous. [A57]
Source: [A57 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0057]

Confusables: low beams are the fog instruction, while clear nighttime conditions permit high beams when no traffic approaches. A work zone can remain hazardous without workers. Mnemonic: slow, scan, space. Glossary: a skid is the condition addressed by the cited steering response; work zones are roadwork areas. No additional braking-system instruction is inferred.
